a.speaker: anchor
a.text: Good evening. Police in Barstow are calling it the worst act of violence in San Bernardino County history.

b.speaker: anchor
b.text: Twenty-four dead at the Sunset Palms Motel. Investigators found a gold star painted on the wall of room 204.

c1.speaker: anchor
c1.text: The motel's night manager, Lyle Harcourt, survived. He has declined to speak to police.

c2.speaker: anchor
c2.text: Among the dead: night manager Lyle Harcourt, who, sources say, once worked in the film industry.

d.speaker: anchor
d.text: One long-term resident spoke to Channel 9.

e1.speaker: earl
e1.text: She told me stay in my room, Earl. Nicest thing anybody said to me all year.

e2.speaker: anchor
e2.text: Correction: the resident was among the victims. Channel 9 regrets the error.

f.speaker: anchor
f.text: In entertainment news: the late-night program HOTSHOT CALIFORNIA has been renewed for a second season.

g.speaker: marv
g.text: Stay tuned, California. We've got a star in the making. And folks? She doesn't even know she's on.
